title: LegalReasoner: Step-wised Verification-Correction for Legal Judgment Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: The paper treats sentencing bias (defined as penalties deviating from standard guidelines without justification) as a specific reasoning error. It evaluates the model's ability to correct this bias through an ablation study, measuring the drop in Case-Level Accuracy (CL-Acc) when the 'Sentencing Bias' correction strategy (which retrieves similar cases and sentencing guidelines to validate penalties) is removed from the LegalReasoner framework.
